Scale: the square plate is about 350 px wide in the photo. If it is a side plate of about 22 cm, that gives roughly 16 px per cm. The bagel half is about 175 px across, so about 10-11 cm. That is a typical bagel diameter, and a half is about 1.5-2 cm thick. A half bagel of this size would weigh about 45-50 g, since a whole bagel is roughly 95 g.

The cream cheese layer covers most of the cut surface, about 70% of it. At a thickness of about 4 mm, the volume is roughly 60 cm² × 0.4 cm × 0.7, or about 17 cm³. That comes to about 17 g, so I'll call it 20 g.

The bagel looks toasted, with some dark spots that could be blueberry or another inclusion.
